english.title: Registered person contravene / fail to maintain record of terminations
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity consisting of the termination of pregnancies, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE NAME..), failed to ensure that a register of termination of pregnancies was maintained, in that

(A)_[it was not completed in respect of a service user at the time the termination was undertaken]_
(B)_[it was not retained for a period of at least 3 years beginning on the date of the last entry]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20(6) and 25 of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
registered person
failed to ensure
a register of service users
having undergone a termination of pregnancy
was maintained AND
completed
in respect of each user
at the time the termination was undertaken AND
retained for a period of not less than 3 years

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 20(1) states the offence only applies to a registered person who is not an English NHS body.
(ii) Regulation 20(6) states that the period of three years which a record must be maintained begins on the date of the last entry.
